notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello, Friends! 

The recent premiere was truly a huge event, wasn't it? You gave us a lot of support, shared multiple comments, gifted us with invaluable feedback, and what's most important, you fell in love with Louise and Mitch!

[h2]We are actively listening to our community and fixing reported bugs and problems - here comes the first [b]Patch 1.0.1[/b]! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063009/0b81eccba29d76f8ab5773c7a5f80d322db2d929.png[/img]

Check out what's changed and tell us how it works for you!

[h3]PATCH NOTES: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the graphical settings: High, Medium, Low,
[*] Added V-Sync option,
[*] Fixed Achievements: "Fast. Not Too Furious", "Student Becomes the Master", "I Have Seen Everything".
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
It's worth mentioning that we are simultaneously releasing this Patch on Steam and Nintendo Switch + soon on all our available platforms.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684400/Best_Month_Ever/

[h3]Remember to join our other social media and let us know what you think about Best Month Ever![/h3]

TWITTER: https://twitter.com/best_month_ever
FACEBOOK: https://facebook.com/bestmonthevergame
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/meEr6Beew2

notes.title: We're on The Big Adventure Event | RELEASE DATE REVEAL + TRAILER
notes.notes:
Dear friends! 

As we've promised in the recent update, big news came out today! 

[h2] That is right - we're revealing the release date of BEST MONTH EVER! [/h2]

Time to bundle up and prepare yourself for a truly adventurous, swashbuckling, and at the same time sentimental and heart-warming journey with Louise and her son, Mitch. It all starts on [b]May 5th, 2022[/b], so pretty close to Mother's Day, what a coincidence! 

Bear in mind, how tough a lonely mother has to be, raising up her son all by herself, and how courageous she is to travel across the turbulent America of the 60s. 

That is, indeed, the most crucial fact for sure.  But we have something extra... some THINGS!
 
The first one is[b] the new trailer[/b]! Check out this truly Hollywoodish announcement teaser!

[previewyoutube=6xF2NfkDHOo;full][/previewyoutube]

And the second one is for those who just cannot wait to live through the story.

[h3] We've released a new DEMO including two chapters of the game! [/h3]

Have more insight into the relationship of Louise and Mitch and get to know her history better, before you dive into it fully.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684400/Best_Month_Ever/


[hr][/hr] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063009/5703c89a76ce448854288efbfe126f5658e0b24b.png[/img]

[h3]BROADCASTING SESSION - January 22nd, 1:00 PM PT[/h3]

Last but definitely not least! As we've announced before, we're taking part in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/thebigadventureevent]THE BIG ADVENTURE EVENT[/url] on STEAM, where we will broadcast some tidbits of the game. The entire event is starting today and lasts up till Jan.24. 

Our LIVE streaming is taking place on Jan.22, at 1 pm. PT (10 pm. CET).

Join us and see for yourself what's the true story of a strong mother in the weird 60's looks like.


Klabater and Warsaw Film School team
